stories.headline: How the proposed merger of two Black banks ignited a fight
stories.body: After two Black banks in the Carolinas announced plans to combine, another lender made a purchase offer that it says is superior.

stories.headline: Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley are dominating the AI stock boom. Here's their edge
stories.body: Wall Street’s Big Three have generated $52 billion in equity trading revenue this year, capturing about 80% of the market on rising margin lending to hedge funds.

stories.headline: Visa says you can thank the labor market for strong spending
stories.body: CEO Ryan McInerney said during the company's fiscal fourth quarter earnings call that a strong labor market was driving the uptick in consumer spending, despite widespread uncertainty. His comments came as Visa posted its highest rate of annual revenue growth in more than 15 years.
